output.summary: KEP-2532 proposes hosting an external cloud controller manager for HUAWEI CLOUD under the Kubernetes organization as a sig-cloud-provider subproject. The KEP is currently implementable at alpha stage.
output.rationale: The project wants a reliable, optimized Cloud Controller Manager that satisfies cloudprovider.Interface for running Kubernetes on HUAWEI CLOUD. The proposal asks for a repository under the Kubernetes organization so the provider can become a community subproject. Networking and storage are explicitly excluded from scope.

evidence.quote: We need a repository under the Kubernetes organization to host our cloud provider specific implementation.
In this project, what we dedicated focus is to provide a reliable and optimized implementation of `Cloud Controller Manager`
The networking and storage support for Kubernetes are out of the scope that will be provided by other projects.
